sources.title: Jev (AI model) - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: Jev is a proprietary artificial intelligence model developed by TypeSafe AI, a San Francisco-based company founded in 2024. It was released in limited early access on 15 September 2026, alongside the announcement of a US$40 million seed round led by DCVC. [1][2] Unlike a large language model (LLM), Jev does not generate natural-language text.

sources.title: GitHub - SiMa-ai/models
sources.snippet: SiMa.ai's subset of compatible models references repositories like Torchvison, ONNX Model Zoo, and Open Model Zoo for OpenVINO. These repositories offer pretrained models in floating-point 32-bit (FP32) format that need to be quantized and compiled for SiMa.ai's MLSoC using the Palette's ModelSDK.
